title: hello world!
content:
As designers, we often showcase our final polished pieces, but it's the process in-between that truly intrigues me. I care about the human experience of creating something new: obsessing over the details, pushing through constant challenges, overcoming self-doubt, and teaching yourself new skills just to complete a project.
Hello, I'm Jasmine, and welcome to my blog! This is really my own personal digital diary dedicated to documenting my growth as an early-career product designer. I'd like to be transparent here about my journey of getting from point A to B (a job!).
Currently: I'm redesigning my portfolio ( they say the 3rd times the charm! 🍀 ), case studies tba.
I was inspired to create this blog by Madani's Blog. I'm a fan of their work and their career trajectory so far (as a hopeful early career designer myself). Upon landing on their blog for the first time, I appreciated something I hadn't seen in a while; an honest and personal webpage. Seeing another designer navigate their early career and speak about their experience so candidly makes me feel less alone :).
